essence: The officiant should prepare the altar with fragrances and other offerings, worship there, and cause the rite to proceed.
After placing the goddess on the altar, the officiant should conduct the wedding rite.
The rite yields a worldly happiness that is difficult to obtain even for kings.
After giving what is prescribed, the devotees, best of the twice-born, turn back.
One should especially make the image from materials such as stone and others.
